decisions.reason: The rye country bread rests directly on the firm's core rye baking know-how, so the firm can read customer response and refine it at low cost, and it stays a stable part of the bread range.
The premium raisin stollen is the flagship, repeatedly earning the German Bread Institute gold medal, which shows the firm masters it and receives clear external feedback on it.

The dark barley malt rye bread builds on established rye expertise, but it has no reported results and overlaps with other rye breads after Product C was removed, so it remains the most likely candidate for range trimming.
The marzipan stollen uses the same confectionery know-how and seasonal gift demand as the award-winning stollen line, so it can be assessed and improved within existing capabilities.
The ancient grain bread is presented as the newest masterpiece and draws on the firm's grain and baking knowledge, so management will give it more time to establish itself in the market.
